title: SyncroBrain → DataLuminary embed grant
description: Reference contract for the optional DataLuminary dashboard embed. DATALUMINARY_EMBED_ENABLED defaults to false. SyncroBrain has shipped a Console iframe host and pull-mode export, still default-off — the default board is a ThingsBoard Dashboard. When enabled, the Gateway mints a short-lived, single-purpose grant against an explicit origin and dashboard allowlist. The browser never holds credentials.

dashboardId.description: Must be present in DATALUMINARY_EMBED_DASHBOARDS, otherwise 403.

origin.description: Must match an entry in DATALUMINARY_EMBED_ORIGINS exactly. Wildcards are rejected.

token.description: Opaque short-lived grant. Carries projectId / dashboardId / aud / exp only — never a DataLuminary API key, ThingsBoard credential or DB connection string.

ttlSeconds.description: DATALUMINARY_EMBED_TTL_SECONDS, default 300, hard cap 900. Not renewable.

scope.description: Read-only. An embed grant never carries command or write scope.

export.description: Optional export reference. Pull-mode aggregates only — never per-point telemetry, never ThingsBoard MQTT.

$comment: The browser never holds credentials. Issuing a grant requires iot.integration:manage and is written to the audit log. Pull export requires iot.integration:view.
